scope: Recognized asynchronous-task raw update presentation only; no control or state transition changes.

policy: Reuse async_tasks record/text guards, with official UTF-8 byte limits for raw fields. Require current supported declaration, exact connection/session and original envelope.update object before assigning internal semantic label.
Spawn requires ID/name/type/canStop and valid optional tool/showInTranscript fields; state update requires ID and completed/failed/stopped. Future/invalid shapes retain unknown title.
Original raw update object, all unknown fields and envelope extras remain retained. Title never grants task ownership, stopping permission or terminal state. No Agent-name branch.
Recognized labels are historical presentation; after connection/session changes, new updates cannot borrow old declarations. No implicit reclassification or control replay.
